attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Maine corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (factor presence standards).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Maine Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false result.me_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold (factor presence standards); result.me_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.me_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required false result.me_has_nexus xdef 0.0 result.me_tax_liability xdef "Maine filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Maine state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. ME requires addback of IRC 199A, depreciation differences. ME allows federal bond interest subtraction, ME municipal bond interest, dividend deduction.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Maine Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.me_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.me_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Maine state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 result.me_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.me_state_subtractions xdef "Maine adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Maine corporate income tax. Applies graduated rates (3.5%, 7.5%, 8.3%, 8.93%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Maine Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.me_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.me_tax_liability xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.me_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Maine corporate tax (graduated rates); Apply Maine graduated rates (3.5%, 7.5%, 8.3%, 8.93%)
No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: // No taxable income - no tax liability 0.0 result.me_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.me_tax_liability xdef result.me_estimated_payments result.me_refund_or_owed xdef "Maine tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto

// No nexus - no tax liability 0.0 result.me_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.me_tax_liability xdef result.me_estimated_payments result.me_refund_or_owed xdef "Maine tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
